$comment: Example only - every field here is a per-institution choice, not a hardcoded default. See spec sections 29 and 70.

acceptanceDeadline._note: If false, offers past their deadline surface on the Expiring/Overdue workbench (section 27) but stay ACCEPTANCE_PENDING until a TPO explicitly calls expireOffer().

_verifiedPlacementOutcomes_note: Outcomes in this list count toward the headline 'Verified Placement' KPI (section 70). Some institutions may also include PLACED_OFFER_ACCEPTED_JOINING_PENDING for early-season reporting - that's a policy choice, made here, not in code.
